title: ConcurrentOutputShared payload
description: Two `command` steps of one `concurrent: true` state that write the same `output:`, compared in any ASCII case as a reserved name is (a darwin release target's file system ignores case). Run at once they would race for one file in the run directory, where a serial run lets the later one win deterministically. The refusal's code is `unsupported_construct` at the later step's `output`, and its message names both step paths (map.rs `StepMap::try_from`).
